original_txt: The document discusses tips and tricks for using SSH more securely, including using SSH agent forwarding to avoid copying private keys, setting lifetime limits for identities added to the agent, and using SSH without direct connection by opening a socket through an untrusted server to a trusted one for authentication purposes only. It also covers potential abuses of SSH agent forwarding and connection multiplexing if the server is compromised.
